IIBA Trunk or Treat
 Oct 22, 2026 5:00 PM - 8:00 PM UTC-05:00
🎃 Trick or treat, Des Moines Analysts! Central Iowa IIBA will be at Trunk or Treat, and our board will be at our own trunk handing out candy. 📅 Thursday, October 22 | 5:00 to 6:00 p.m. 📍 Genesis Health Club, 4875 Mills Civic Pkwy, West Des Moines Expect a live DJ, mini-games, and treats from local trunk-decorating pros. It's a family-friendly night, and no registration is needed. Just show up! Come find our trunk, say hello, and meet fellow members of our Central Iowa business analysis community. Costumes encouraged. Bring the family and a friend who might enjoy meeting us.
